note: Known-acceptable drift and raw-SQL object inventory for the migration smoke lane (#434). diff-whitelist: the exact `prisma migrate diff` lines the CI drift check may drop — each row names the object, its kind, and WHY the drift is acceptable; the filter (scripts/db/migrateDiffFilter.mjs) matches lines exactly, so any definition change re-surfaces as drift. This half is hand-maintained: a row whose line prisma no longer emits at all is pruned by hand on regen, and the smoke lane's own exact matching is what surfaces a changed line. post-push-owned: every durable object the prisma/post-push.sql closure creates — regenerate with scripts/db/gen-post-push-manifest.mjs; the completeness test (src/test/postPushManifest.test.ts) pins THIS half against the closure in both directions (a missing or stale row is red), and gen --check compares full rows (name, kind, file, why).

diff-whitelist.name: memories_user_id_idx
diff-whitelist.why: Partial index (WHERE clause) in the baseline migration; Prisma schema language cannot express a WHERE on an index, so the diff wants to 'fix' it into non-partial form on every run.

diff-whitelist.name: users_external_app_id_external_id_key
diff-whitelist.why: Partial unique index in the baseline migration; same Prisma limitation as memories_user_id_idx — the diff wants to drop the partiality it cannot model.

diff-whitelist.name: node_embeddings_embedding_hnsw
diff-whitelist.why: pgvector HNSW index, created by raw SQL (post-push.sql on dev/test, the migration in prod — prod never runs post-push.sql). Prisma cannot express it, so the diff wants to DROP it; it must survive.

diff-whitelist.name: nodes_tsv_gin
diff-whitelist.why: GIN index over the nodes.tsv generated tsvector column (cor:api:090 findNodes). Raw SQL in post-push.sql/migrations; Prisma models neither the column nor the index, so the diff wants to DROP it.

diff-whitelist.name: nodes.tsv
diff-whitelist.why: STORED generated tsvector column (cor:api:090). Prisma schema language does not model generated columns, so the diff wants to DROP the column; prod needs it (no post-push.sql there), so the drop is whitelisted.

diff-whitelist.name: nodes_properties_gin
diff-whitelist.why: GIN(jsonb_path_ops) index (#719 where-query); Prisma cannot express the operator class, so the diff wants to DROP it. Same prod-needs-it rationale as the HNSW index.

diff-whitelist.name: nodes_data_gin
diff-whitelist.why: GIN(jsonb_path_ops) index (#719 where-query), same rationale as nodes_properties_gin.

diff-whitelist.name: agent_tasks.task_number
diff-whitelist.why: #2553: task_number is NOT NULL in the DB (the invariants file fills it; no row ever lacks its identity) but optional in schema.prisma so a writer that states neither still type-checks and the assign-number trigger fills it. The diff wants to DROP NOT NULL; whitelisted so the invariant stays.

diff-whitelist.name: agent_tasks.handle
